WITH filtered_ab AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM advancedbehavior
  WHERE peercorr > 0.149
),
matched AS (
  SELECT 
    fab.translink,
    tr.ordertypedist
  FROM filtered_ab fab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = fab.translink
  WHERE tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
),
combination_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    translink,
    ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY translink, ordertypedist
),
total_by_ordertype AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    SUM(count) as total_count
  FROM combination_counts
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  cc.translink,
  cc.ordertypedist,
  cc.count,
  CAST(cc.count AS FLOAT) / tbo.total_count as fraction
FROM combination_counts cc
JOIN total_by_ordertype tbo ON cc.ordertypedist = tbo.ordertypedist
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;
